subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with using dithering to add a highlight and form shadow to the snowball image?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might you use dithering to create a form shadow across the bottom right of the snowball image?


Solution:

A light, analogous color, such as light blue, should be used to add a form shadow across the bottom of the snowball image. Pixels should be spaced out in an irregular diagonal pattern to add depth to the image.



Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might you arrange pixels in the top left corner to add a highlight to the snowball image?


Solution:

Pixels spaced out in a diagonal pattern should be added to the top left corner of the snowball image to add a highlight.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which colors should be used to replace the black outline in the snowball image?


Solution:

The black pixels in the outline of the image should be replaced with the colors used as the base and form shadow.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to modify an original pixel art image!


An analogous color and dithering should be used to create a form shadow across the bottom right of the snowball. 


The snowball image should have a highlight that uses dithering in the top left corner.


The outline of the snowball should be replaced with the colors being used in the image.


Use the tools in the paint editor to update the snowball image!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original pixel art images. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:
